title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
We are seeking a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team in Brazil. This role is focused on ensuring smooth logistics operations, strong partner performance, and a reliable delivery experience. You will work closely with carriers, pharmacies, and internal teams to solve issues, manage daily operations, and support continuous improvements.


Responsibilities

  • Monitor daily performance of logistics partners and share KPI updates with internal teams.
  • Support leadership in carrier negotiations by providing operational data and performance insights.
  • Act as the main contact for carriers and the CX team to resolve delivery issues quickly.
  • Manage critical delivery cases by coordinating with internal teams and carriers to avoid escalations.
  • Make decisions on reshipments, new delivery attempts, and order cancellations together with pharmacies and partners.
  • Maintain accurate delivery information in internal systems (tracking numbers, links, status updates).
  • Support logistics improvement initiatives, including testing new partners, adjusting order allocation, and building monitoring processes.


Qualifications

  • Intermediate to advanced English.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or related fields.
  • 2+ years of experience in Supply Chain, Logistics, or Operations, ideally in fast-paced or tech-driven environments.
  • Good understanding of logistics operations and partner management.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to analyze operational data.
  • Proficiency in Excel; experience with ERP, logistics systems, or BI tools is a plus.
  • Strong communication, organization, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Collaborative mindset and comfort working with teams in different countries.


Salary & Benefits

  • Stock option plan
  • Private medical insurance
  • Gym & wellness benefit with Wellhub
  • English classes benefit with Cambly
  • 30 days holidays yearly (calendar days)
  • International exposure with direct interactions with the UK team
  • Annual company retreat
  • A fun and friendly working environment with sharp and motivated co-workers

title: Coordenador Comercial
description:
SOBRE A EMPRESA ✨

Somos a Up Brasil, multinacional francesa com presença em 25 países e com mais de 23 milhões de beneficiários. Oferecemos soluções simples e completas para facilitar o dia a dia de empresas, estabelecimentos e usuários. Em 2025, fomos reconhecidos como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar ao conquistar o selo GPTW (Great Place to Work), reforçando nosso compromisso com um ambiente interno de crescimento, com valores sólidos e uma cultura que valoriza pessoas. Promovemos um ambiente pautado por equidade, solidariedade, empreendedorismo, inovação e compromisso. Queremos gente com brilho nos olhos, que goste de desafios e que queira escrever sua própria história. E aí, vem com a gente?


ATIVIDADES

  • Planejar, acompanhar e garantir o cumprimento dos indicadores com foco em B2C;
  • Coordenar e apoiar a equipe de consultores comerciais, orientando quanto a estratégias, abordagem e priorização de oportunidades;
  • Monitorar indicadores de performance (KPIs) e propor ações corretivas ou de melhoria de resultados;
  • Realizar análises de mercado e concorrência, identificando oportunidades de expansão e crescimento;
  • Promover a capacitação e desenvolvimento da equipe, estimulando o atingimento de resultados e o alinhamento à cultura organizacional;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das políticas comerciais e padrões de atendimento definidos pela empresa;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas de Inteligência de Negócio, Marketing, Operações e Atendimento ao Cliente para garantir a melhor experiência do consumidor;
  • Relacionamento com Clientes Corporativos (RH), realizando visitas e reuniões com áreas de RH de empresas clientes, compreendendo as necessidades dos usuários finais (colaboradores das empresas), traduzindo essas necessidades em oportunidades de campanhas e produtos;
  • Criar campanhas alinhadas às demandas dos usuários e objetivos de negócio, trabalhando com parceiros estratégicos para viabilizar ações, garantindo inovação e criatividade nas propostas;
  • Colaboração com times internos, encaminhando sugestões de produtos e demandas para as respectivas áreas responsáveis por P&D, trabalhado em conjunto com as áreas responsáveis pelo e-commerce interno para viabilização das campanhas;
  • Monitorar performance das campanhas e propor ajustes para maximizar conversão e rentabilidade, buscando novos modelos de monetização voltados ao consumidor final;
  • Atuar estrategicamente para sustentar o modelo de negócio frente à concorrência e margens reduzidas.



REQUISITOS

  • Ensino Superior completo em Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda, Administração, Relações Públicas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em operações B2C;
  • Experiência em empresas de tecnologia ou serviços digitais
  • • Habilidade de negociação e relacionamento com áreas de RH;
  • • Habilidade de transformar insights em ações concretas.


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

  • Local de trabalho: São Paulo / SP – Faria Lima;
  • Horário de trabalho: 08:30 às 18:18;
  • Regime híbrido: 2 dias da semana presencial / 3 dias da semana remoto.


BENEFÍCIOS

title: Analista de compras
description:
O Analista de Compras na Autron é responsável por conduzir os processos de compras (nacionais e internacionais) de forma estratégica e eficiente, garantindo qualidade, prazos e o melhor custo benefício, assegurando o abastecimento e dando suporte às áreas de vendas e produção, dessa forma contribuindo para os resultados e a competitividade do negócio.


RESPONSABILIDADES-CHAVE:

- Conduzir compras de itens produtivos nacionais e internacionais, atuando via ERP e junto aos fornecedores para garantir abastecimento contínuo.

- Gerenciar pedidos de compra, acompanhar prazos, logística de entrega/retirada, e conferir documentos fiscais e comerciais (NF, boletos, invoices, packing list etc.).

- Homologar e desenvolver fornecedores, garantindo uma base confiável e alinhada a critérios técnicos e comerciais.

- Analisar necessidades e históricos de consumo para otimizar níveis de estoque, evitando faltas e desperdícios.

- Participar de reuniões de projetos e elaborar relatórios que apoiem orçamentos e negociações.


O QUE BUSCAMOS:

- Formação em Engenharia, Comércio Exterior Administração ou Supply Chain.

- Experiência comprovada em Compras Técnicas e/ou Supply Chain.

- Vivência com compras internacionais e nacionais.

- Inglês fluente (mandatório).

- Domínio de ERP, Excel avançado e interpretação de documentos fiscais/comerciais.

- Perfil analítico, organizado, comunicativo e com habilidade para negociação.


Modalidade de trabalho: presencial de segunda a quinta-feira - home-office às sextas-feiras. Horário Comercial.


Contratação CLT + benefícios de mercado.

title: Arquiteto(a) de RPA - Automation Anywhere - Brasil
description:
Você na Deloitte:

Na Deloitte, buscamos pessoas que queiram gerar impactos positivos todos os dias. Impulsionamos talentos para que possam se desenvolver em um ambiente colaborativo, com times diversos e que tragam energia, empoderamento, interação e conexões. O nosso crescimento é exponencial porque os talentos que recrutamos possuem os nossos valores em suas essências.

Liderar o caminho, fomentar a inclusão, colaborar para mensurar impactos, servir com integridade e cuidar uns dos outros são pontos essenciais e inegociáveis para fortalecer ainda mais o nosso propósito.

Você terá a oportunidade de evoluir sua carreira na maior empresa de serviços profissionais do mundo como Arquiteto de RPA no time de Engineering . Na sua rotina, você irá:

  • Servir como um integrador entre as necessidades de negócios e as soluções de tecnologia, ajudando a criar soluções de tecnologia para atender às necessidades de negócios.
  • Desenvolver e revisar os requisitos do sistema, projetar a solução, redefinir os negócios, apresentar o protótipo e liderar os testes de nossas soluções tecnológicas personalizadas;
  • Avaliação e otimização de arquitetura de aplicativos, incluindo definição, documentação e implementação de novas arquiteturas de aplicativos;
  • Direcionar construção nas fábricas contratadas, concepção de solução, modelagem de dados e construção de APIs;

Acreditamos na força dos talentos que preparamos. Eles transformam de fato, impactam organizações, impulsionam mais talentos e criam oportunidades. Que tal fazer parte da maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo? Escolha seu impacto.


O que você precisa para se candidatar à vaga?

  • Graduação em Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência de Dados, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística, Física ou Química; ou graduação em nível superior em qualquer área de conhecimento acrescida de curso de pós-graduação (especialização, mestrado ou doutorado) com duração mínima de 360 horas na área de conhecimento de Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Experiência profissional mínima de 7 (sete) anos como Analista de Sistemas, Desenvolvedor ou cargo correlato
  • Certificação Master na ferramenta Automation Anywhere ou similar (de nível mais alto) em outra plataforma.

O que estará disponível para você?

Desenvolvimento profissional

É claro que cuidaríamos do seu desenvolvimento aqui na Deloitte! Queremos que você alcance seus objetivos profissionais e pessoais e, por isso, contamos com Universidade Corporativa, acesso a plataformas online de aprendizado, plataforma de idiomas com mais de 7.500 conteúdos e cerca de 60 cursos divididos por nível, área de atuação, habilidades profissionais e interesses, e até uma plataforma que reúne diversas instituições de ensino, fornecendo descontos exclusivos para profissionais Deloitte e seus dependentes.

Além disso, oferecemos um plano de carreira estruturado, com mentoria de profissionais da Deloitte por meio de um(a) coach, que poderá ouvir seus desafios e apoiar para que consiga evoluir tanto com habilidades técnicas, quanto com habilidades comportamentais com base na própria experiência. É ótimo ter uma pessoa mentora, não é mesmo?

Cuidados com o seu bem-estar

Aqui na Deloitte, acreditamos que saúde e bem-estar não são apenas projetos, e sim uma mudança de cultura. Queremos que você coloque em prática todo o seu talento e desenvolva uma carreira de sucesso com a gente, com equilíbrio entre Mente, Corpo e Propósito. Para isso, contamos com mais de 30 benefícios, como:

  • Serviço de telemedicina para que você consiga fazer uma pré-avaliação sem precisar sair de casa!
  • Family Strategy: programa destinados à profissionais gestantes e futuros papais que terão todo apoio possível neste momento tão especial
  • Wellhub (Gympass) para colocar os exercícios físicos em dia
  • Dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário, para celebrar uma das pessoas mais importantes de sua vida
  • Canal de apoio psicológico e Serviço Social

(Mais) Benefícios

  • Assistência médica e odontológica! Para que você faça check-ups e cuide de você, em primeiro lugar
  • Participação nos lucros. Afinal, sem os nossos talentos, não poderíamos crescer exponencialmente
  • Auxílio-internet, para apoiar no trabalho em modelo híbrido
  • Seguro de vida
  • Cartão Multibenefícios*

*Você receberá um valor em seu cartão e poderá distribuí-lo entre as opções que melhor se adequam às suas necessidades de acordo com as regras do programa.

Oportunidade de fazer parte de uma cultura inclusiva na Deloitte Brasil

Você pode ser quem realmente é com oportunidade igual de crescimento. Para reforçar esse compromisso, desenvolvemos a estratégia D&I com os 5 pilares – Origens, Delas, LGBT+, Inclui e Gerações. Destacamos que todas as nossas vagas estão abertas ao público PcD.

Esperamos você neste time!

title: Supervisão de Retenção
description:

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES:

  • Realizar escutas de monitoramento constantes para acompanhar o processo de retenção e garantir a qualidade dos atendimentos;

REQUISITOS:

  • Experiência em liderança de time de retenção B2C;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de indicadores;
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados de retenção e propor melhorias;
  • Ensino superior completo em áreas relacionadas.



Nosso jeito de trabalhar

Na Petlove nós somos apaixonados por pets e por pessoas. Por isso, buscamos garantir que somos inclusivos e formamos times diversos, sempre procurando refletir em nossas decisões nosso compromisso com esse tema! Consideramos enriquecedor contratar pessoas com deficiência, de gêneros e orientação sexual diversas, incluindo todas as etnias e religiões, além de todas as idades e demais marcadores de identidade. Temos certeza que só assim formaremos times inconformados, ágeis e comprometidos com o nosso propósito.


Se identificou? Então vem com a gente!

Onde tem pet, tem love — só falta você!

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.

Team Management and Deliverables: Responsible for managing a local Keeta team of approximately 30-40 people in Brazil, responsible for uploading and verifying all merchant information, ensuring data efficiency, completeness, and accuracy. This requires balancing limited resources and delivering high-quality team results on time.

  1. Highly responsible and unwaveringly committed to achieving goals and results.
  2. Effective in resource management and problem-solving.
  3. A strong learner, eager to continuously acquire new skills and adapt to a constantly changing business environment.
  4. A proactive team player who supports colleagues and enhances team efficiency through excellent communication skills.
  5. Native Portuguese speaker, fluent in English (listening, speaking, reading, and writing).
  6. Experience in merchant operations support is preferred.


Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 57 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

Atuar como Coordenador(a) de Projetos de Suprimentos, liderando processos estratégicos de compras e contratos para obras civis, infraestrutura crítica e aquisição de equipamentos CAPEX. title: Corporate Lawyer / Account Manager
description:
We’re Hiring! Account Manager (Corporate Management Services) – Brazil (On site)


Corporate Administrator | Company Management Services


Amicorp Group is expanding our team in Brazil, and we are looking for an experienced Account Manager (Corporate Administrator) to join our Corporate Management Services division.


If you enjoy working with international clients, managing complex corporate structures, and acting as a trusted advisor on legal, administrative, and corporate governance matters — this opportunity is for you.


About the Role

As a Account Manager, you will manage a portfolio of clients and ensure their legal and corporate structures remain fully compliant and in good standing. You will guide clients on regulatory, fiscal, and administrative matters while supporting the growth of the business through exceptional service and relationship building.

You will be responsible for:


✔ Managing and administering companies, partnerships, and trusts

✔ Structuring and maintaining corporate entities for clients

✔ Providing guidance on corporate governance, regulations, and fiscal opportunities

✔ Reviewing and preparing corporate documents: minutes, proxies, registers, resolutions

✔ Coordinating with internal teams (Accounting, Compliance, Legal)

✔ Ensuring timely and accurate billing through Maconomy

✔ Monitoring financial targets, chargeability, and productivity

✔ Ensuring KYC compliance and meeting communication KPIs

✔ Acting as a trusted advisor and building long-term client relationships

✔ Supporting business development through client referrals and portfolio growth


This is a client-facing, revenue-generating role for someone who enjoys ownership, responsibility, and building meaningful professional relationships.


What We’re Looking For


Required qualifications:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law, Business, Accounting, Tax, or related areas

Experience with foreign structures in BVI or Cayman

4 years of experience in corporate services, financial services, or corporate governance

Strong knowledge of corporate structures, regulatory requirements, and compliance

Experience with director/shareholder changes

Fluent English; additional languages are a plus

Strong communication and client relationship skills

Commercial mindset and target-driven approach

Ability to work independently and handle a full portfolio

Hands-on, proactive, organized, and detail-oriented


Why Join Amicorp?

At Amicorp, you will be part of a global organization with a local, dynamic team environment. We offer a collaborative, multicultural workplace where you will have direct impact on client portfolios and contribute to the growth of the business.


Interested?

If this role fits your background and career goals, we would love to hear from you!

Apply or send your CV to: c.garci a@amicorp.com


Join us and be part of a global group shaping the future of corporate and fiduciary services.

title: Enterprise Account Executive (New Business Sales) - Brasil
description:
Enterprise Account Executive (New Business Sales) - Brasil (São Paolo)


A little about ADP: We are a comprehensive global provider of cloud-based human capital management (HCM) solutions that unite HR, payroll, talent, time, tax and benefits administration and a leader in business outsourcing services, analytics, and compliance expertise. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating a down-to-earth culture that embraces our core values, welcomes ideas, encourages innovation, and values belonging. We've received recognition for our work by many esteemed organizations, learn more at ADP Awards and Recognition .


The Role:

  • New business sales to Enterprise clients who have 1,000 – 2,500 employees in Brasil (can have even higher numbers of employees globally)
  • Selling across ADP Brasil’s Payroll and HR solutions – full sales and delivery support in place for both local and global deals
  • The types of deals that you get to work on will vary; it could be a local deal taking 3-9 month with 3/4 stakeholders at $100,000 (USD) in year 1 revenue, or significantly more for a larger global deal.


Key Duties / Tasks:

  • Collaborate with your sales leaders to create your annual business plan, determining sales targets and actions to achieve the established quota; achieve and exceed quota through the assigned portfolio
  • Produce a 120-Day Prospect Report, which identifies potential companies and actions to close a contract - use a variety of tools available at your disposal to plan, execute, and track your targeted new business
  • Arrange prospect appointments and undertake virtual and in-person meetings / demos
  • Identify customer dissatisfaction with existing products and services and execute action plans to resolve issues and retain customers
  • Co-ordinate internal resource and support, in line with a structured sales process (provided), to appropriately run your deals and maximise success
  • Work with presales when necessary to develop solutions to fit prospect needs
  • Present response to meet prospect needs with existing product service solution
  • Maintain chosen ADP data base management tool and adhere to the current defined sales processes


Education and Experience:

  • 3-5 years of new business sales experience in IT Solutions / Services / HR in Brazil
  • Full Right to Work and a full driving licence in Brasil
  • Commutable to São Paolo 3 days per week
  • Experience in outbound lead generation and proactively growing a new business territory
  • A background of carrying and achieving / exceeding annual net new business annual quotas excess of $300k (USD)
  • Track record of managing complex sales cycles and closing deals in the $50-100k (USD) annual revenue range
  • Ideally you will have experience selling multi country products, but this is not essential
  • Must be fluent in Portuguese and English


What We Offer. This role offers the perfect platform for sales professionals to be fully supported to win global, complex deals, develop their career, and earn:


  • World class, structured induction programme
  • Highly competitive salary and compensation plan
  • A world class induction programme and individual on-going training – both locally and internationally
  • Realistic targets and earnings - we support our associates to overachieve.
  • We also celebrate success regularly with early starts, quarterly and annual awards, clubs and trips. Recent examples include everything from all-inclusive cruises, to local sports events and luxury 5 start resort vacations.
  • Excellent sales support and enablement teams to help you get there! We offer Sales Development Representatives and Marketing support to help generate leads. Then there's a full pre-sales team who are there to support you with everything from client assessments, recommendation documentation and software demonstrations
  • Global brand, 75+ years of heritage, and a strong presence in Brasil and LATAM
  • Flexible benefits program


If this sounds like you and what you're looking for, or if you'd like to learn more, then please do get in touch!

description:

title: Strategy and Planning Expert
description:
What You'll Do

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly strategic and analytical Strategy & Planning Expert to join our team and lead the business evolution of our Innovation vertical. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing the business model, managing the end-to-end P&L, and serving as the Project Management Office (PMO) for key implementation projects. The ideal candidate will have a strong blend of strategic vision, financial acumen, and operational process design skills to drive sustainable growth and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Business Model Evolution : Design and continuously evolve the business model for the Innovation vertical, including market entry strategies, new service offerings, and go-to-market approaches.
  • P&L Management : Own and manage the P&L for the vertical, including financial forecasting, budget planning, and variance analysis. Identify and execute initiatives to improve profitability and top-line growth.

title: Associate Teacher, Primary Division
description:

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. Deep Collaboration, Constant Evolution

Collaboration here isn't a buzzword: it's woven into everything we do. At Avenues, no one teaches on an island. Substantial time to collaborate is embedded into the schedule. Teacher teams, across multiple disciplines, design learning experiences together for a whole grade level. Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. With operations in Riau Province, Sumatra, Indonesia, APRIL employs around 9,000 people directly and supports more than 90,000 livelihoods through its wider ecosystem, contributing to sustainable growth and community development.


More details of APRIL at:

Market Intelligence & Reporting

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with supply chain, logistics, and finance teams to ensure smooth execution.
  • Support regional marketing or promotional initiatives to strengthen brand presence.
  • Participate in trade shows, customer visits, and business reviews as required.


Job Requirements


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Engineering, or Science; MBA preferred.
  • 6–10 years of sales experience in the paperboard, packaging, or related materials industry .
  • Experience in managing customer accounts across North or Latin America.

Skills & Competencies

Great Place to Work®

Top 100 Most Loved Workplace®

Melhor empregador do estado de acordo com a Forbes



OBJETIVO PRINCIPAL: Realizar todas as etapas de um processo de regulação de sinistros. Seus principais objetivos incluem garantir uma resposta eficiente e eficaz aos sinistros relatados pelos segurados, assegurando uma resolução justa e satisfatória para todas as partes envolvidas. Atuar na análise detalhada das circunstâncias do sinistro, na avaliação dos danos e na determinação das coberturas aplicáveis à apólice de seguro. Conduzir as comunicações com os segurados, corretores, agentes e outros envolvidos no processo, esclarecendo dúvidas, fornecendo orientações e negociando acordos quando necessário. O Analista de Sinistros também trabalha em estreita colaboração com outras áreas internas, como jurídico, financeiro e atendimento ao cliente, para resolver pendências e garantir a conformidade com as políticas e regulamentações do setor de seguros. Suas atividades envolvem desde a coleta inicial de informações sobre o sinistro até a conclusão do processo, incluindo a liquidação de valores de indenização e o encerramento do caso de forma satisfatória para todas as partes. Este profissional tem um maior foco técnico, com uma relação mais profunda com as etapas de Regulação de Sinistros.


FUNÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES ESSENCIAIS:


  • Receber e registrar notificações de sinistros relatados por segurados, corretores ou agentes, e realizar uma análise inicial das circunstâncias do sinistro (pré-análise)
  • Conduzir investigações detalhadas sobre a validade e a extensão do sinistro, incluindo a avaliação de danos, coleta de evidências e entrevistas com testemunhas, quando necessário.
  • Realizar vistoria remota assistida através das tecnologias da Sedgwick coletando imagens para compor o laudo/processo do Sinistro, de acordo com as especificidades de cada ramo, condições gerais do produto e determinações dos Clientes.
  • Determinar a aplicabilidade das coberturas da apólice ao sinistro reportado, verificando os termos, condições e limitações da apólice de seguro.
  • Estabelecer comunicação com os segurados para fornecer orientações sobre o processo de regulação de sinistros, esclarecer dúvidas e solicitar documentação adicional, quando necessário.
  • Negociar acordos e resoluções com os segurados, corretores, agentes ou terceiros envolvidos no sinistro, com o objetivo de alcançar uma solução justa e satisfatória para todas as partes, quando aplicável ao escopo contratado pelos Clientes da Sedgwick.
  • Solicitar e coletar documentos relevantes relacionados ao sinistro, como registros médicos, estimativas de reparo, relatórios policiais e outros documentos necessários para a análise e avaliação do sinistro, de acordo com a documentação exigida por cada Cliente para as coberturas dos produtos comercializados.
  • Determinar a responsabilidade das partes envolvidas no sinistro e avaliar os impactos na resolução do sinistro, considerando as leis, regulamentos, condições gerais do produto, coberturas e demais aspectos do sinistro que está sendo analisado, resultando em um pagamento total, parcial ou a uma negativa de indenização.
  • Avaliar os danos causados pelo sinistro e determinar os valores de indenização de acordo com as coberturas da apólice e os procedimentos estabelecidos pela Seguradora.
  • Preparar relatórios detalhados sobre a investigação, análise e resolução do sinistro, documentando todas as etapas do processo e as decisões tomadas, de acordo com o Book de Regras de cada Cliente da Sedgwick.
  • Monitorar e gerenciar pendências relacionadas aos sinistros em aberto, garantindo que sejam resolvidas de forma oportuna e eficiente, buscando apoio das áreas internas da Sedgwick, Seguradora ou Corretora e/ou buscando solucionar pendências junto ao cliente, como por exemplo a obtenção de documentação complementar.
  • Registrar todas as atividades, decisões e informações relevantes sobre os sinistros nos sistemas de gerenciamento de sinistros da Sedgwick e/ou dos Clientes, garantindo a precisão e a integridade dos dados.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com outras áreas internas, como jurídico, atendimento ao cliente, financeiro e etc, para resolver questões e pendências relacionadas aos sinistros, buscando sua solução com a maior qualidade possível no menor tempo possível.
  • Acompanhar o progresso e o status dos processos de regulação de sinistros, fornecendo atualizações regulares aos segurados e outras partes interessadas conforme determinado no Book de Regras de cada Cliente, de acordo com as respectivas réguas de comunicação pré-estabelecidas assim como os canais disponíveis.
  • Garantir que todas as atividades e decisões relacionadas à regulação de sinistros estejam em conformidade com as leis, regulamentação SUSEP, condições gerais do produto e suas respectivas coberturas e especificidades determinadas pelos Clientes da Sedgwick formalizadas em um Book de Regras.



FUNÇÕES E RESPONSABILIDADES ADICIONAIS:

  • Executar análise e solucionar pendências.
  • Avaliar circunstâncias do sinistro e coberturas reclamadas vs coberturas contratadas
  • Obter informações e evidências relevantes (como vistorias e/ou documentos complementares)
  • Atender KPI's e SLA's e identificar oportunidade de melhorias.
  • Realizar acompanhamentos, buscar soluções e acionar áreas Internas da Sedgwick ou do Cliente dependendo da situação apresentada no contato, objetivando compartilhar o caso e buscar apoio com a solução de pendências.



REQUISITOS


Educação e licenças

  • Superior Completo ou Cursando: Administração, Negócios ou Correlatas, Ciências Atuariais, Economia ou Finanças ou Correlatas, Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Ciências da Computação ou Correlatas, Gestão de Seguros ou Gestão de Riscos ou Direito ou Engenharia.
  • Diferencial caso possua Certificações SUSEP.


Experiência

  • Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência em uma posição similar atuando em um dos ramos: Responsabilidade civil (RC), Riscos Nomeados e Compreensivo empresarial.
  • Experiência anterior em BPO's, seguradoras ou corretoras
  • Compreensão detalhada das políticas de seguros, incluindo termos, condições, coberturas e exclusões das apólices, para determinar a aplicabilidade ao sinistro.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de investigação para coletar evidências, realizar entrevistas e verificar informações relacionadas ao sinistro.
  • Capacidade de interpretar e analisar documentos legais relevantes para o sinistro, como apólices de seguro, relatórios policiais, registros médicos, contratos de locação entre outros.
  • Gerenciamento de documentos, incluindo verificação de integridade, organização e indexação adequada dos documentos
  • Conhecimento das leis e regulamentos que regem a indústria de seguros, incluindo legislação de seguros, responsabilidade civil, proteção ao consumidor e privacidade de dados.

title: Analista de Controladoria de Fundos
description:
Sobre a Prisma:

A Prisma Capital é uma empresa de investimentos alternativos fundada em 2017 que oferece soluções criativas para problemas complexos que exigem capital de longo prazo. A equipe da Prisma Capital é experiente, multidisciplinar e com um histórico de mais de R$ 12bi implantados com retornos atrativos. A Prisma tem sede em São Paulo, 66 funcionários e possui em torno de R$ 22bi sob gestão.


A Prisma tem um mandato de investimento altamente flexível que inclui um espectro completo de transações estruturadas, independentemente do tamanho, classe de ativo ou setor. A Prisma acredita que essa abordagem multiestratégia é fundamental para a geração de retornos não correlacionados com os ciclos macroeconômicos brasileiros.


Overview da Posição:

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Controladoria com boa comunicação, senso crítico, com forte atenção aos detalhes e comprometido com a alta qualidade das entregas. O profissional será responsável por criar, implementar e acompanhar controles rigorosos para os ativos e passivos de toda a estrutura de fundos onshore e offshore da nossa gestora, além de coordenar o processo de auditoria e revisar as demonstrações financeiras e contábeis dos fundos.


Responsabilidade:

  • Controle das carteiras (Divulgação de cotas, reconciliação de informações divulgadas pelo administrador, validação de cálculos);
  • Suporte a áreas internas (Relatórios para investidores, fornecimento de informações regulatórias);
  • Suporte ao processo de auditoria dos fundos e revisão de demonstrações financeiras;
  • Controle de cotistas (Reconciliação das posições, análise de distribuições, chamadas de capital etc.);
  • Análise da rentabilidade dos fundos (Variações nos valores dos ativos e passivos, análise dos impactos mais relevantes);
  • Marcação a mercado de diversos tipos de ativos, líquidos e ilíquidos (Revisão e validação da precificação dos ativos em carteira, comparações com modelagens gerenciais);
  • Coordenação do processo de avaliação de ativos de Private Equity;


Desejável:

  • Coordenação das atividades de US tax compliance e reports de FATCA/CRS com prestadores;
  • Interface com administrador de fundos offshore sediados em Cayman, Canadá e USA, instruindo e revisando a contabilidade, demonstrações financeiras e notas explicativas.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Superior completo em Ciências Exatas, Econômicas, Contábeis, Administração e Engenharias;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Excel avançado;
  • Experiência anterior em asset management ou similar;
  • Diferencial: experiência em fundos offshore com investidores estrangeiros.

title: Software Engineer
description:

In Addition to a Competitive Compensation Package, WSO2 Offers:

  • A work culture and environment where we value both hard work AND flexibility.

We've built our business on a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We believe it's important to foster an environment that values and respects each individual's strengths, perspectives, and ideas. Doing so not only drives innovation; it also ensures that we can create superior experiences for our customers, partners, and employees worldwide. We value the diversity of our team regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, gender, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, or veteran or marital status, and we do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

title: Product Owner
description:
ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY


JOB DESCRIPTION

The Product Owner (PO) for the Revenue Management System (RMS) is responsible for shaping and delivering integrated solutions that support pricing, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization. This role involves managing initiatives that span data engineering, machine learning, and user-facing interfaces. In addition to gathering and managing business requirements, the PO will be responsible for overseeing the full delivery lifecycle to ensure successful execution from concept through release.


DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and maintain a backlog of features and enhancements spanning data pipelines, predictive models, and RMS user interfaces.

Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to optimize pricing strategies and demand forecasting.

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into detailed epics and user stories with clear descriptions, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

Own the full delivery lifecycle of features and enhancements, ensuring timely execution, alignment with stakeholders, and readiness for deployment.

Collaborate with Data Engineering on requirements for data sourcing, integration, and quality.

Partner with Data Science to define, deploy, and iterate on ML models and pricing algorithms.

Align with UI/UX and front-end teams to ensure a seamless user experience.

Facilitate cross-functional workshops and planning sessions with business stakeholders.

Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and user adoption.

Ensure accurate documentation in Confluence and Jira for themes, epics, and tasks.

Coordinate with QA to validate features and ensure delivery meets requirements.

Promote continuous iteration based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.

Drive change management and support user training for new RMS features.

Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards.

Identify and mitigate risks associated with process and system changes.

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Perform other job-related functions as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree


FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Business Management, Data Analytics, or related fields


EXPERIENCE;

  • At least 3 years of experience in end-to-end product ownership, product management, or delivery of data or optimization platforms.
  • Experience working across Data Engineering, Data Science, and UI Development teams, as well with multiple stakeholders and brand Revenue Management teams.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional teams.
  • Industry experience in cruise, travel, or enterprise data systems is a plus.


COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Exposure to revenue management, pricing systems, or forecasting tools is preferred
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and iterative development
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ML model lifecycle, and modern UI patterns
  • Ability to define and refine user stories across technical and business domains
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and backlog management tools
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills
  • Understanding of change management principles and user adoption strategies
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, cross-functional environments


CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES

Add certifications/licenses (if any) here.

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification preferred
  • Product Management or Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus

title: NGS Scientific & Technical Operations Manager – LATAM
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY



MGI is at the forefront of genomics innovation, delivering cutting-edge sequencing technologies and advancing life sciences research worldwide. We are dedicated to enabling affordable, effective healthcare solutions and expanding our impact across the Americas. If you’re passionate about genomics, NGS, and making a real difference in healthcare and research, join us on this exciting journey toward accessible innovation for all.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are seeking an experienced NGS Scientific & Technical Operations Manager – LATAM to lead our Scientists, Field Service Engineers, Bioinformatics, Quality, and Customer Experience teams across Latin America. This leadership role requires a solid scientific foundation in molecular biology, genetics, bioinformatics, or related life sciences, combined with strong operational and people management skills. You will ensure exceptional customer support, technical excellence, and continuous improvement across all post-sales service functions in the region.



RESPONSIBILITIES



  • Report directly to the Head of LATAM and collaborate closely with Global Technical Support, Training, Sales, and Service Operations leaders.
  • Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary team including Field Application Scientists, Field Service Engineers, Field Bioinformaticians, and Customer Support professionals.
  • Oversee customer satisfaction and operational efficiency, ensuring that service requests, installations, and technical issues are managed effectively and within expected timelines.
  • Define individual training and development needs across the technical team and recommend staffing plans and hiring strategies.
  • Establish measurable goals and performance indicators (e.g., response time, first-time resolution, quality metrics).
  • Manage regional service operations including resource allocation, travel budgets, spare part inventory, and field reporting.
  • Ensure accurate communication and coordination between LATAM and global operations, cascading critical updates and initiatives.
  • Serve as the technical and operational lead for the Customer Experience Center (CEC) and Demo Lab, driving technical demonstrations and customer engagement.
  • Maintain alignment with global quality standards, ensuring compliance, traceability, and continuous improvement of support processes.
  • Able to support and coordinate teams across the LATAM time zones.


QUALIFICATIONS



  • Master’s degree (or higher) in Genetics, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Strong academic background or work experience in NGS (Next Generation Sequencing) is highly preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in technical support, field service, or applications management, ideally within the genomics or life sciences industry.
  • Proven leadership and people management skills, with experience guiding technical and scientific teams.
  • Excellent communication and organizational abilities; capable of navigating global structures and driving results across functions.
  • Willingness to travel regionally and internationally, including occasional training or collaboration trips to China.


PAY RANGE AND COMPENSATION PACKAGE



MGI offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package to employees and their dependents (including domestic partners), which includes:



  • Medical and dental coverage
  • Travel insurance
  • Meal vouchers
  • Gym allowance


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT



MGI is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

  • Proven experience in technology assessment and system implementation projects in the investment environment.
  • Solid knowledge of core architectures, with experience integrating with Matera considered a plus.
  • Familiarity with integration technology stacks and cloud architectures.
  • Strong background in system architecture, integration models, and data modeling.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and client management skills.
  • Advanced English.


Nice to Have

  • Experience leading transformation programs in large financial institutions.
  • Knowledge of agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, Jira).
  • Experience with data analytics, investment reporting, or risk systems.
  • Certifications or specialization courses in financial markets, architecture, or cloud technologies.
  • Spanish proficiency valued.


What We Offer

  • Coordenar o processo de demonstrações financeiras estatutárias, junto aos auditores externos.


Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis (obrigatória) com CRC ativo .
  • Experiência sólida em coordenação contábil, contabilidade geral ou controladoria.
  • Conhecimento avançado de US GAAP e das normas brasileiras (CPC/IFRS).
  • Vivência com rotinas tributárias e validação de impostos indiretos.
  • Inglês avançado (oral e escrito) para interação com equipes globais.

title: Data Warehouse Architect
description:
Databricks Data Warehouse Architect About the role:

One of the largest companies in the world in the Gaming industry is seeking a hands-on Data Architect with DataWarehouse Engineer expertise in Databricks (DBX) and AWS-native data services to spearhead the design and implementation of a new data warehouse instance for a major product line. This role will involve building from the ground up—architecting scalable pipelines, optimizing lakehouse performance, and integrating seamlessly with diverse real-time and batch data sources across AWS.

The ideal candidate is passionate about data architecture , thrives in fast-moving environments, and has a proven track record of setting up high-performance lakehouse platforms on Databricks with a strong foundation in data warehousing principles .

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and deploy a new Databricks Lakehouse instance tailored to the client’s product-level data needs.
  • Architect and implement robust data ingestion pipelines using Spark (PySpark/Scala) and Delta Lake.
  • Integrate AWS-native services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda) with Databricks for optimized performance and scalability.
  • Define data models, optimize query performance, and establish warehouse governance best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, data scientists, and DevOps to streamline data workflows.
  • Maintain CI/CD, preferably DBX for data pipelines using GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Monitor data jobs and resolve performance bottlenecks or failures across environments.
Required Skills & Experience: Databricks / Lakehouse Architecture
  • End-to-end setup of Databricks workspaces and Unity Catalog
  • Expertise in Delta Lake internals , file compaction, and schema enforcement
  • Advanced PySpark/SQL skills for ETL and transformations
AWS Native Integration
  • Deep experience with AWS Glue , S3 , Redshift Spectrum , Lambda , and Athena
  • IAM and VPC configuration knowledge for secure cloud integrations
Data Warehousing & Modeling
  • Strong grasp of modern dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas)
  • Experience setting up lakehouse design patterns for mixed workloads
Automation & DevOps
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for data engineering using tools like DBX, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps
  • Proficient in monitoring tools like CloudWatch, Datadog, or New Relic for data pipelines
Bonus/Nice to Have:
  • Experience supporting gaming or real-time analytics workloads
  • Familiarity with Airflow , Kafka , or EventBridge
  • Exposure to data privacy and compliance practices (GDPR, CCPA)
Other Details:
  • Location : Latin America (LATAM) region - Remote, USA - Remote
  • Length : 1+ Year

title: Product Owner (PO) Técnico/Analista de Negocios Sr
description:
Product Owner, PO Técnico ou Analista de Negócios Sênior

INGLES FLUENTE



  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner, PO Técnico ou Analista de Negócios Sênior em projetos de modernização de dados, Business Intelligence ou APIs.
  • Forte aptidão técnica e fluência na comunicação com times de Engenharia de Dados e Backend.
  • Experiência prática com GraphQL e análise de payloads JSON complexos.
  • Habilidade para lidar com grandes volumes de dados e experiência em análise de datasets para validação.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em migração de dados de sistemas legacy para cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de crédito ou antifraude.
  • Experiência na definição de KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) para monitoramento de qualidade de dados (Data Quality).


Resumo do Cargo

Buscamos um Product Owner (PO) Técnico altamente motivado para liderar a frente de consumo de dados e relatórios dentro da workstream de modernização. O PO será a ponte essencial entre as necessidades de negócio e a complexidade técnica da integração de dados em arquiteturas cloud-native . O foco principal é garantir que os relatórios sejam construídos com precisão e eficiência, utilizando dados provenientes de sistemas legados migrados e do Data Fabric global.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão do Produto (Relatórios e Dados):
  • Definir, priorizar e manter o backlog de recursos (funcionalidades e histórias de usuário) necessários para o consumo de dados do Data Fabric e a construção dos relatórios finais.
  • Atuar como stakeholder primário para validação de entregas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Especialista em Integração e API:
  • Profundo conhecimento no consumo de dados via API , definindo padrões de requisição e resposta para payloads complexos.
  • Conhecimento prático em GraphQL é mandatório, sendo responsável por desenhar as queries mais eficientes para extração e composição dos dados no Orquestrador de Relatórios.
  • Trabalhar ativamente com o time de Engenharia para definir os schemas de dados e a governança de APIs.
  • Qualidade e Migração de Dados:
  • Liderar a fase de análise de dados migrados de sistemas legados para a nuvem , garantindo a integridade, a qualidade e a equivalência das informações.
  • Definir e coordenar a execução de Testes de Equivalência (Equivalence Testing) para garantir que os relatórios construídos na nova arquitetura (Data Fabric) correspondam exatamente aos resultados do sistema legado.
  • Colaboração Técnica e Operacional:
  • Colaborar diretamente com os Data Stewards e times de Engenharia de Dados para entender a origem, o tratamento e a disponibilização dos dados no Data Fabric.
  • Liderar o discovery e o refinamento de requisitos complexos, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis e performáticas.

title: Reporter
description:
Risk Event-Driven Distressed (REDD) Intelligence is looking for a reporter to cover corporates in Brazil out of our office in Sao Paulo.

The reporter will have a notable track record covering and breaking news and a solid understanding of the corporate credit space, working closely with our experienced team of financial reporters and analysts to cover performing/distressed corporates in Brazil.


Day-to-day activities include:


  • Breaking news on corporate finance and operations, turnarounds and restructurings, legal, regulatory and market developments affecting Brazilian issuers
  • Working closely with our market-leading team of reporters and analysts across the global emerging markets
  • Analysis of finance, economics, legal situations and other data affecting corporates under coverage


Requirements:


  • A minimum three to five years’ experience with coverage of Brazil’s corporate space
  • A deep network of contacts in the business, asset management, banking, and legal communities
  • Knowledge of the corporate bond market and global/onshore credit
  • Facility with financial data and analysis related to coverage of the corporate space
  • Knowledge of the local dynamics affecting corporates under coverage
  • The ability to work collaboratively in a deadline-driven, fast-paced environment
  • Excellent English language writing skills


About REDD:


REDD produces real-time news and analysis on emerging market corporate and sovereign event-driven special situations, helping asset managers, bankers, and advisers assess opportunities in the high-yield and high-grade markets.

REDD is a strong proponent of gender and racial diversity, and an equal opportunity employer. We are a motivated team of free thinkers and expect our team members to be personable and dynamic, encouraging “out of the box” thinking and the ability to discuss and appreciate different points of view to avoid the blind spots presented by group think.

We can offer you an opportunity to pursue a challenging but rewarding career with ample progression within a diverse international organisation. We also offer a market-leading competitive salary package and flexible working arrangements.

Headquartered in London with bureaus across the global emerging markets, REDD Intelligence’s team is made up of professionals with investment banking, legal and financial reporting experience, leveraging regional relationships to report on catalysts related to a universe of over 3,500 companies and sovereigns under coverage.

title: Head of Charging
description:
About Vammo


Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.


Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others. We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.


The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.


About the role


As the Head of Charging Operations, you will be the executive leader responsible for defining and executing the strategy for the reliability, efficiency, and scalability of Vammo's battery-swapping network which is the heart of our customer experience.


Reporting directly to the Founders, you will build and lead the organization that ensures not only the expansion of our charging network, but also its 24/7 operation. You will be the ultimate owner of this network efficiency and quality, managing the LiveOps, Field Operations, and Commercial Charging Teams, being responsible for preparing the area for 10x growth. This is a mission-critical leadership role that demands strategic vision, the ability to build high-performance teams, and a deep sense of ownership.


What You'll Do

  • Define the end-to-end Charging Ops strategy, including the detailed strategic plan and OKRs. Own the design of processes, systems, and team architecture required to scale the operation by 10x, improve efficiency, and increase customer satisfaction.
  • Own the area's full budget and P&L, managing and optimizing costs to meet company goals.
  • Define and monitor the area's core OKRs and KPIs.
  • Recruit, develop, and lead high-performing teams across LiveOps, Field Operations, and Infrastructure. Define the area's vision and culture, focusing on urgency, accountability, and data-driven problem-solving.
  • Serve as the ultimate owner of network uptime, reliability, and incident response, ensuring riders always have batteries available.
  • Own the end-to-end energy strategy to reduce cost per kWh, including managing procurement, exploring free market (Mercado Livre) opportunities, and implementing efficiency initiatives.
  • Lead the commercial and expansion strategy for the network, defining site selection criteria to secure prime locations and network balance, negotiating strategic partnerships, and overseeing installation/launch playbooks.
  • Build proactive Customer Experience (CX) processes to communicate downtime and protect our NPS.
  • Serve as the strategic voice of operations for the Product and Engineering teams, providing real-world feedback and guiding the hardware/software roadmap to improve operability.
  • Act as the final escalation point for critical incidents, conduct post-mortems, and implement structural changes to prevent recurrence.


What We're Looking For

  • 8-12 years professional experience
  • Excellent knowledge of Brazil and Latin American business practices
  • Track record of scoping, building, training and leading large multidisciplinary teams
  • Proven expertise in process design, optimization, and creating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for large-scale operation
  • An analytical and strategic mindset, with strong data-driven decision-making skills and experience defining OKRs
  • Executive communication and influencing skills, capable of aligning tech, executive, and field teams.
  • Excels in planning and executing initiatives of varying durations and scales while effectively managing stakeholders.
  • Fosters collaborative and respectful work environments
  • Technical Curiosity, a drive to understand how systems, hardware, and data truly work and how to optimize them.
  • Experience in high-growth (hyper-growth) startups
  • Experience managing 24/7 systems.
  • Experience setting and leading priorities, objectives and strategic direction for entire orgs
  • Experience in mobility, energy, logistics, IoT, or telecommunications is a plus.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.
  • Strong alignment with the company’s values


Benefits

  • A leadership role at fast-growing startup changing the face of mobility in Latin America, backed by some of the best venture capitalists in the world
  • Working at a mission driven company - we are reducing carbon emissions across the world and putting more money into the pocket of disenfranchised populations
  • Being surrounded by a talented and ambitious team that wants to build something big 
  • Freedom to take on as much responsibility as you dare, allowing you to develop quickly
  • Competitive salary package
  • Opportunity to own a piece of the company - equity package
  • Health Insurance

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Enterprise Architect , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid , in the city of São Paulo .


In this role you will:

The Enterprise Architect will be centrally responsible for the strategic definition and implementation of Canada's enterprise architecture, working from the design and governance of systems to the integration of technological platforms and operational mining processes. Its mission is to translate business objectives into modern, secure and scalable architectures, aligned with international standards and the automation, sustainability and innovation goals of the group.

This professional will work in partnership with the global Enterprise Architect and cross-functional areas (IT, Operations, Engineering, ESG), ensuring that each solution offers efficient integration between on-premises, cloud, and industrial automation environments. He will have a profound influence on technology decisions, playing an advisory role with Canadian and Brazilian leadership, promoting a collaborative, innovative and results-oriented environment.

To succeed, you must demonstrate strategic vision, technical leadership, exceptional intercultural communication skills, and mastery of regulatory requirements in both Canada and Brazil.


Main Responsibilities

  • Define, document and evolve integrated Enterprise Architecture models (business, applications, data, technology), using frameworks such as TOGAF/ArchiMate and aligning with the strategic demands of mining, sustainability and digital transformation.
  • Act as a technical reference, leading cross-functional teams, promoting the consolidation of solutions between IT, OT and industrial automation, ensuring adherence to global corporate standards.
  • Evaluate and validate new technologies, platforms, services and methods (Cloud, Edge Computing, Digital Twins, IoT, Analytics, Cybersecurity), always considering the best practices in the mineral and natural resources sector.
  • Develop and maintain architectural criteria that prioritize security, regulatory compliance (LGPD, PIPEDA, GDPR), performance, sustainability and operational integration between Canada and Brazil.
  • Prepare detailed documentation (LLD/HLD, reference architectures, guidelines), transferring knowledge and mentoring technical and business teams both locally and internationally.
  • Lead communication between technical, operations, engineering, and global leaders, promoting efficient collaboration and respecting cultural differences.
  • Continuously analyze technological, regulatory and business trends, proposing standards and improvements that position as an international reference in sustainable and digital mining.
  • Participate directly in the supplier selection/merger processes, prioritizing interoperability, innovation and return on investment in critical projects.


Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Proven experience (minimum of 8 years in IT, with at least 5 as an enterprise architect or similar strategic role in Large Enterprise or mining/resources).
  • Deep knowledge of the mineral, energy or industrial sector, preferably previous experience in large global operations (e.g., Petrobras, Rio Tinto, Barrick Gold, Anglo American).
  • Mastery of the main enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF: Practitioner, ArchiMate, Zachman, DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Excellence in the use of cloud technologies (Azure, AWS, GCP) and data platforms, cross-system integration (ERP SAP/Oracle, SCADA, IIoT, Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse).
  • Ability to design hybrid architectures (on-premises, cloud, edge), industrial data integration (sensing, automation, dashboards, analytics).
  • Strong performance in compliance, industrial cybersecurity (OT/IT Convergence), data protection, disaster recovery and business continuity.
  • Experience in multinational/cross-border projects, especially Brazil-Canada.
  • Fluent English (technical communication, executive meetings, documentation), advanced Portuguese is a strategic differential for integration between teams.


Soft Skills

  • Advanced communication skills, capable of transmitting complex technical concepts to different audiences (executives, engineers, IT, business).
  • Global strategic vision, aligning local and global initiatives with corporate objectives in sustainable mining, innovation and automation.
  • Analytical and solution-oriented thinking, with high ability to navigate complex, multifunctional and multicultural environments.
  • Collaborative leadership – mentoring, consensus building, influence without direct authority, and excellent internal/external networking skills.
  • Management of priorities, organization and resilience in the face of multiple parallel projects and ad-hoc demands.
  • Absolute focus on results, delivering tangible value for operation, innovation and sustainability.


Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • TOGAF (Expert) certification, AWS/Azure/GCP Solution Architect, CISA, PMP/Agile, specializations in ESG, digital mining, cyber OT/IT.
  • Hands-on experience with emerging platforms: Digital Twins, AI/ML/Ops, real-time streaming (Kafka, Spark Streaming, Flink), infrastructures as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Experience in due diligence processes, merger & acquisition, integration of multi-company systems.
  • Active participation in architecture forums, mining, global events, technical publications or international presentations.
  • Background with SAP, Oracle, SIEMENS, Rockwell, GE Predix, Azure IoT/Edge/Analytics solutions, sustainability frameworks and ESG reporting.


Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Align the needs of global business, Canada and Brazil with the vision of enterprise architecture and technological roadmap.
  • Ensure that all solutions meet requirements for scalability, security, performance, regulatory compliance and operational excellence.
  • To be an agent of transformation and innovation, proposing disruptive solutions to digital and operational challenges in the mining sector.
  • Mentor and develop technical capacity of the teams, promoting architecture culture, documentation and standardization.
  • Lead the preparation and presentation of business cases, technical justifications and architectural alternatives to senior executives and regional and global boards.
  • Organize, sustain and evolve architecture governance, support strategic decisions and ensure the permanent alignment of solutions with business objectives and international compliance.


Additional Comments:

This is a key role in Canada's technological and cultural transformation, requiring active action in multicultural environments, with flexibility for travel, meetings in different time zones and continuous adaptation to trends in the mining sector and global architecture. The presence of fluent English is mandatory, while mastery of Portuguese enhances Brazil-Canada integration, directly impacting the success of the project. Technical certifications, previous experience in operations, participation in modernization/digitalization initiatives and innovative mindset will be major differentials in the selection process.

title: Senior Technical Manager – Fixed Networks & Infrastructure

Operational Excellence

Technical Mastery

  • Eliminate network bottlenecks through proactive capacity planning and infrastructure optimization
  • Orchestrate vendor relationships, negotiate contracts, and enforce SLA compliance
  • Establish comprehensive technical documentation and deployment playbooks
  • Champion adoption of 5G integration, edge computing, and automated network management


What You Bring


Required Experience

  • Experience in telecommunications infrastructure and in senior technical leadership;
  • Proven track record deploying large-scale networks (1MM+ subscribers or equivalent);
  • Expert-level troubleshooting across physical and logical layers;
  • Demonstrated success managing technical support operations and ITIL frameworks.


Bearer Network Expertise (Must Have)

  • Optical Transport: DWDM, OTN (OTU/ODU), SDH/SONET, WDM systems, EDFA, dispersion management
  • Fiber Infrastructure: Dark fiber, OPGW, aerial/underground deployment, OTDR testing
  • Metro & Aggregation: Carrier Ethernet (MEF), MPLS-TP, Metro WDM, PTN
  • IP/MPLS Backbone: Core routing, MPLS VPN (L2/L3), traffic engineering, segment routing, BGP/ISIS
  • Access Networks: PON (GPON/XG-PON/XGS-PON/NG-PON2), Active Ethernet, FTTx architectures
  • Microwave Transmission: P2P links, spectrum planning, link budget calculations


Technical Skills

  • Network protocols: BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, RSVP, LDP, TCP/IP, SIP, VoIP
  • Logical provisioning systems, EMS/NMS platforms, network orchestration tools
  • Advanced diagnostics: OTDR, OSA, BERT, spectrum analyzers, protocol analyzers
  • OSS/BSS systems, monitoring tools (Nagios, Zabbix, SolarWinds), ServiceNow, Jira
  • Automation: Ansible, Python scripting
  • Cloud-native architectures, Docker/Kubernetes, DevOps methodologies
  • Multi-vendor platforms: ZTE, Huawei, Ciena, Nokia, Cisco optical/routing equipment


Deployment & Operations

  • Complex cutover management and phased rollout strategies with zero service disruption
  • Multi-tier support framework design and escalation matrix implementation
  • Data-driven spares management and predictive maintenance programs
  • Vendor negotiation and RMA cycle management
  • Process automation and provisioning timeline reduction


Leadership Capabilities

  • Proven ability to identify and develop high-potential talent, assessing how candidates think and solve problems under pressure
  • Building high-performing teams in fast-paced, demanding environments
  • Strategic mindset balancing operational needs with long-term architectural vision
  • Cross-functional collaboration across deployment, support, procurement, and vendor management


Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent.
  • MBA in Project Management is a plus.
  • Certifications highly valued: CCNP/CCIE (Service Provider), JNCIP-SP, ITIL Foundation/Expert
  • Bilingual: Portuguese (native/fluent) and English (advanced communication as primary working language)


Plus/Nice to Have

  • Wireless network experience (4G/5G RAN, microwave backhaul, small cells, DAS)
  • Wireless-wireline convergence architectures
  • Spectrum management and RF planning knowledge


Why Join Us


✅ Strategic Influence: Direct access to executive leadership shaping company direction

✅ Technical Autonomy: Select technologies, design architectures, and optimize operations

✅ Operational Impact: Transform deployment, support, and maintenance organization-wide

✅ Market Leadership: Partner with tier-1 carriers on

title: Technical Compliance Officer (Brazil)
description:
We are a leading global fintech company providing cross-border payment solutions to enterprises worldwide, with operations across North America, Europe, the UK, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East. As we strategically expand into the Brazilian market, we are seeking a seasoned Technical Compliance Officer (Brazil) to ensure full compliance of our local operations with Brazilian financial regulations, data protection laws (LGPD), AML/KYC requirements, and payment system frameworks. This role will serve as the primary liaison with local regulators (e.g., Banco Central do Brasil, Receita Federal, ANPD), lead compliance implementation, adapt technical systems to regulatory expectations, and support routine audits, while closely collaborating with global compliance and engineering teams to embed compliance into product development.


Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary technical compliance liaison between the company and Brazilian regulators (including but not limited to Banco Central do Brasil, CVM, ANPD, Receita Federal);representing the engineering in regulatory engagements that involve system architecture, data flows, business contingency, audit logging, and other technical implementation aspects of compliance.
  • Participate in Brazil market-related requirements and project reviews, providing technical compliance oversight to assess requirements and ensure that products, technical architecture, and operational processes comply with Brazilian financial, payments, and data privacy regulations (such as LGPD, PIX-related rules, and BCB Resolutions), thereby enabling legally compliant business operations.;
  • Collaborate with global Compliance, Legal, Product, and Engineering teams to translate regulatory requirements into actionable technical specifications and system controls;
  • Support internal and external audits (e.g., SOX, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001) and prepare regulatory filings and compliance reports;
  • Continuously monitor regulatory developments in Brazil, assess impact on existing business and technical architecture, and propose mitigation strategies;
  • Drive the systematic and standardized documentation of technical artifacts to enhance compliance efficiency and auditability;
  • Provide compliance training and guidance to local business teams to foster a strong compliance culture.



Qualifications:


Required Qualifications

  • Language : Native-level Portuguese (written and spoken); fluent English for global collaboration;
  • Local Regulatory Knowledge : Deep understanding of Brazil’s financial regulatory landscape, including BCB payment system rules (e.g., PIX, SPB), AML/CFT regulations, and LGPD data protection requirements;
  • Technical Acumen : Familiarity with modern payment technology architectures (e.g., API-first, microservices, cloud infrastructure); ability to engage engineering teams on technical details such as data flows, encryption, and audit logging;
  • Hands-on Experience : Direct experience engaging with Brazilian regulators, submitting licensing applications, or managing on-site inspections;
  • Education : Bachelor’s degree or higher in Law, Finance, Information Technology, Risk Management, or related field.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Hold professional certifications such as CISSP, CAMS, CRCM, or similar;
  • Prior experience in fintech, payment institutions, or banking compliance roles;
  • Familiarity with international compliance standards (e.g., FATF Recommendations, GDPR, PCI-DSS) and their local implementation;
  • Experience working in multicultural teams and supporting cross-border compliance initiatives.


What We Offer


  • Opportunity to collaborate with world-class compliance and engineering experts;
  • Continuous professional development and learning resources;
  • Inclusive, diverse, and results-driven culture.

title: Operations Manager
description:
As we prepare to launch our licensed operations in Brazil, we’re seeking a strategic yet hands-on Operations Manager to establish and lead all operational functions on the ground in São Paulo.

Leveraging Ant International’s core platforms for payments, compliance, reporting, and risk, your critical role is to operationalize these global capabilities in the Brazilian context: defining local workflows, adapting procedures to meet BACEN expectations across EMI, payments, and lending (SCD), managing internal partners, and ensuring flawless execution from day one.

With a lean local team and key functions still centralized, you’ll wear multiple hats: acting as builder, executor, regulator liaison as needed, and team leader—while contributing directly to how global practices evolve to serve Brazil’s unique market.


Key Responsibilities:


1. Local Operational Design & Regulatory Alignment

  • Lead the design and implementation of Brazil-specific operational frameworks across two license types: Payment Institution (EMI and PISP) and SCD (lending)—ensuring full alignment with current and upcoming BACEN requirements;
  • Translate regulatory expectations into actionable operational controls, feeding insights back to global teams to refine shared standards;
  • Define end-to-end procedures for payment processing (PIX, TED/DOC), loan disbursement (for SCD), reconciliation, and incident management—mapped to Ant’s global infrastructure;
  • Support Compliance and Business teams on operational matters during licensing reviews, audits, and ongoing supervision.


2. Cross-Border Execution & Global Integration

  • Partner closely with Ant International’s headquarters in China, working with product, risk, compliance, and engineering teams to ensure Brazil’s operational needs are reflected in global systems and policies;
  • Validate that data flows, reporting logic, and control mechanisms support accurate, timely submissions to Brazilian authorities (e.g., SISBACEN, periodic EMI/SCD reports, RFB, Sisbajud/CNJ, Simba, STA, local authorities in general, etc.);
  • Identify gaps between global processes and local regulatory or market realities—and drive pragmatic, compliant adaptations without compromising system integrity.


3. Hands-On Operational Leadership

  • In this foundational phase, personally execute critical tasks: validate regulatory reports, investigate transaction failures, reconcile settlement accounts, and test live workflows;
  • Manage relationships with local banks, payment scheme participants (e.g., PIX connectors), credit bureaus, and third-party vendors—ensuring seamless integration with Ant’s ecosystem;
  • Build and mentor the first wave of local operations talent as the team scales, instilling a culture of compliance, precision, and customer trust.


4. Risk, Controls & Scalability

  • Implement robust operational risk frameworks tailored to Brazil’s multi-product environment (payments + lending), leveraging Ant Group’s global standards while addressing local threats;
  • Maintain a dynamic risk register, lead incident reviews, and ensure all operational activities support BACEN’s fit-and-proper, capital adequacy, and consumer protection expectations;
  • Design scalable processes that can grow with volume—by optimizing configurations, automation, and human oversight within the existing global structure.


Who You Are:


Deep Expertise in Brazil’s Regulated Financial Landscape

  • 7+ years in operations, compliance, or risk within Brazilian banking, fintech, or financial services;
  • Essential: Direct experience with BACEN-regulated entities, particularly EMIs, Payment Institutions, or SCDs—including licensing processes, ongoing reporting, AML/KYC, reserve rules, and consumer credit regulations;
  • Basic knowledge of development/programming languages, APIs, and XML files is a plus;
  • Fluency in Portuguese (native or fluent) and English (professional proficiency/advanced). Chinese is a plus, not mandatory. Must be based in São Paulo.


Builder Mindset with Global Awareness

  • Proven ability to launch or scale operations in early-stage, regulated environments—you’ve operated where structure meets scrappiness;
  • Experience collaborating with international or offshore teams; you know how to influence without authority and translate local needs into global action, with a resilient and problem-solving-oriented approach;
  • Understand that excellence lies not in rebuilding systems, but in making world-class infrastructure work and adapt itself flawlessly in Brazil.


Operational Rigor & Accountability

  • Obsessive about accuracy, audit readiness, and regulatory detail—but also pragmatic and solution-oriented;
  • Equally comfortable presenting to regulators and debugging a reconciliation file at midnight;
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Law, Economics, or related field. Advanced degrees or certifications (e.g., CRC, CEA) are valued but not required.

title: Product Owner | Recebíveis e Garantias
description:

title: Analista de Precificação Sênior
description:
Somos a Copa Energia, uma empresa brasileira, referência em soluções energéticas e à frente das próximas inovações do setor para construir um amanhã melhor a partir de uma matriz energética mais limpa.
